description: Release the owner's exact 131-setting Dead City tuned preset from 11 Oct 2026. Ten default values have changed versus the prior release: pickup guide opacity=0; ON-first streetlight flicker=1, probability=.38, peak=1.2, illumination range=.5, warmth=.1, flash distance=9m; rain opacity=.48, radius=7m and brightness=.6. The other 121 defaults already match. Version the developer tuning storage to ignore old test-only overrides on the first update, preserving separately stored gameplay saves, orientation, haptics and Metal FM 10% volume. Keep all scene lamps (instanced bulbs, light pools, actual lights and non-instanced bulbs) on the shared local lighting pulse. Hide both LIVE TEST VALUES menu button/panel and FPS widget, while leaving developer code available behind a single source flag.
